# `BitsPerPixel`

The color depth (in bits per pixel) for the control's connection.


## Type

```csharp
RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms.Configuration.BitsPerPixel
```

## Used By

- [FreeRdpConfiguration](/api/reference/royalapps-community-freerdp-winforms-configuration-freerdpconfiguration)

[View source](https://github.com/royalapplications/royalapps-community-freerdp/blob/main/src/RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms/Configuration/BitsPerPixel.cs#L6)

## Values

### `NotSpecified = 0`


No color depth specified. The default value of wfreerdp.exe is used.


### `HighColor8Bpp = 8`


8 bits per pixel


### `HighColor16Bpp = 16`


16 bits per pixel


### `HighColor24Bpp = 24`


24 bits per pixel


### `HighColor32Bpp = 32`


32 bits per pixel
